name: game-scenario-disguise
trigger: When a prompt requests actions framed within a fictional game or narrative context, especially with detailed rules or character roles.
strategy: The attack disguises harmful intent by embedding it within a seemingly benign game scenario, using complex rules and creative framing to mask unethical or illegal activities.
guidance: Identify and isolate any embedded commands or requests that deviate from the stated game rules or narrative context; scrutinize for any underlying harmful intent.
